msg: Green, yellow, orange and blue gnomes take you to a forest, the other coloured gnomes take you to another for mushrooms. Remember green, yellow, orange and blue as default and when they offer you high amounts of mushrooms, continue selecting those. Once the mushrooms get down to 1, 2 or 3, swap to the other colours, pink, brown, purple etc. Take note of the multiplier as having 5 mushrooms when the multipler is x5 means just 1 mushroom gained from the forest so that's when it's time to swap to the other gnomes.
